phase3_findings.description: test_probe_memory_ignores_segment_directories records only builtins.open calls, so its check that only chroma.sqlite3 is opened cannot see opens through os.open, io.open / Path.open or sqlite3.connect; a later read of a segment file through those routes would still pass.

Same gap in test_probe_memory_ignores_segment_directories: patching builtins.open leaves os.open, io.open and Path.open opens unrecorded. The cited line range does not match the head file (test at lines 362-386), so it does not corroborate F-1 by signature.

The except OSError branch always says the store file is 'not writable by this process', even for non-permission errors (IsADirectoryError, ELOOP, EIO, ETXTBSY); it formats differently from the sentinel branch, which uses {exc}.
except FileNotFoundError: return treats a chroma.sqlite3 symlink with a missing target the same as an absent file, so preflight passes and the store may fail to open later at the target.
